meta.title: Yahtzee Match-W hybrid benchmark
meta.modelNote: Rounds before 12 use Exact-W; rounds 12-13 use Match-W (P(win)+0.5*P(tie), exact dice and exact CPU policy distribution). CPU always uses its shipped Exact-W policy.
meta.rules: Repo rules: +35 upper bonus at 63; +100 extra Yahtzee after a 50; an extra Yahtzee may be banked in any open box.
